data.summary:
This **FORTIFICATION** has three effects:

- its parts must each be no more than 1" from another of its parts when it is set up
- friendly **ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY** models may be set up on, or end any kind of move on, its floor sections
- each **ADEPTA SORORITAS** unit of yours within 1" of it may perform 1 extra Act of Faith per phase
